answer: A claim is staked in nectar, one drop per verified job of this epoch, and pinned to a public atlas that plots every claim by its cohort of origin. It counts only when three identities from three different cohorts wander to it and each confirms the trail from the atlas record. Corroboration from the same cohort is a sour echo, not a confirmation: the claim is void and the staked nectar of every identity that touched it is forfeited. A farm of fifty clones owes 150 outside visits, and each visit confirms one claim only, so no corroboration can be lent to a clone.
